source.pages: Audioscripts pp.166-170（scripts/_ket_out/t2ts-test6.txt 文本层，仅转 Exam Practice 听力段；口语稿与页眉页码行未转）

parts.1:
Questions 1–6

1 Which is Nick’s band?

Boy: What’s Nick’s band like?

Girl: Brilliant! He’s the singer, and he plays the guitar as well.

Boy: Who plays the piano?

Girl: Oh, I don’t know the guy’s name, but it’s actually a keyboard, not a piano. And there’s this other guy on another keyboard. That’s for the drums.

Boy: Oh really? I didn’t know you could do that!

2 What is in the fridge?

Girl: Hi Dad.

Dad: Hi love. Look, I’m in the shop. Can you go and look in the fridge and tell me what food we have?

Girl: One second… OK, we’ve got mushrooms… and a box of eggs.

Dad: Can you open and check it’s full?

Girl: The box of eggs? OK. Oh, there are none left. And the milk bottle’s nearly empty too. Can you get some more?

3 How does the boy’s mother want him to travel home?

Boy: Mum! I’m getting the bus into town now with three friends.

Mum: Well, if you get a taxi, won’t that be quicker? And if you share the cost, it might be cheaper, too.

Boy: Well, maybe you’re right.

Mum: And afterwards, why don’t you come all the way back on foot? I’m not paying for a taxi both ways!

Boy: OK Mum, but it’s too far to walk. I’ll get the bus home!

4 Which platform does the train to London leave from?

Girl: Excuse me, I’m looking for the London train.

Man: It’s platform seven if you want the train that’s arriving from London. Or do you mean you are travelling to London?

Girl: Exactly I’m on my way to London.

Man: That train goes from platform one, in seven minutes. It’s usually from eleven, but that’s closed until it’s repaired.

Girl: Great, thank you.

5 Where is the boy’s pencil case now?

Boy: Mum, is my pencil case in the kitchen?

Mum: It’s usually in your jacket pocket.

Boy: No. We were in the car, so maybe it fell out of my jacket pocket and is still there.

Mum: Oh yes! I saw it on the back seat. I’ll leave the car key on the kitchen table. Can you go out and get it yourself?

Boy: OK.
parts.2:
Questions 6–10

Girl: Hi, I’ve got some details about our cinema visit on Saturday. The film’s called Sam’s Adventure. Yeah… oh! I think I told you the wrong date. I said June the fourth, didn’t I? Well, sorry, it’s not, it’s the fifth. I hope that’s still OK. The only cinema where it’s on is called the Mercia Cinema. I’ll spell that; it’s M-E-R-C-I-A. I’ve never been before, so I didn’t know exactly where it was. It’s on the other side of town, on Green Street, which is next to Park Street, where all the shops are. Let’s meet there, at the cinema. It says the film starts at two fifty-five, but there’ll be all those boring adverts first. I don’t want to watch them, so shall we see each other there at ten past three? Oh, and you know how most films are about a hundred minutes long? Well this one’s only seventy-five. It’s really short! So we’ll have time to do something else afterwards. See you!
parts.3:
Questions 11–15

Boy: How was Jack’s party?

Marina: Brilliant! He did it now, not at the end of the school year, because he just heard that he was chosen for the national hockey team for his age. That’s under 13s; his birthday’s August.

Boy: Cool. And your friend’s band were playing, right?

Marina: Yeah, they played songs from films. We wanted to dance, but the room was too small!

Boy: What about food?

Marina: Jack’s parents offered to cook, but not for so many people. So Jack asked everyone to bring snacks to share.

Boy: Cheaper than ordering pizza! What time did it finish?

Marina: Eleven. I couldn’t believe it was time to go home so soon! On the bus home, I had to borrow a friend’s jacket, because it was cold outside.

Boy: Did you meet lots of new people?

Marina: Actually I already knew everyone. The best thing was, well, my classmate Zara’s been really sad after her older sister moved to Australia. She misses her a lot but the party made her feel better. By the end, she looked so happy.

Boy: Ah, I’m sure you were glad for her.

Marina: Exactly, I really was.
parts.4:
Questions 16–20

16 You will hear a girl talking to her father about studying French. What does she want him to do?

Girl: Dad, I’ve got my French speaking exam next week. I need someone to ask me stuff in French so I can practise.

Dad: Oh. What do you want to talk about?

Girl: About films I like. My favourite actors. And if I watch films in French. That kind of thing.

Dad: OK, I can do that for you. But you probably know more French vocabulary than I can remember.

17 You will hear two friends talking at a swimming pool. What are they talking about?

Man 1: Arrgghh! The water’s really cold! It’s horrible!

Man 2: Yeah. Don’t pools always have to be between 25 and 30 degrees or something like that?

Man 1: I don’t know. But swimming in cold water’s no fun. And this is freezing.

Man 2: It’s the same if it’s too hot. You quickly get too exhausted to swim. Shall we just get out?

Man 1: OK. Let’s ask for our money back.

18 You will hear a maths teacher talking to two pupils. What is she surprised about?

Teacher: I’ve checked everyone’s maths homework. Tom and Layla, you both got the same questions right. And when you got one wrong, both of you had exactly the same wrong answer. That shouldn’t be possible. Did one of you look at the other person’s work and write down the same answer? I need to hear the truth.

19 You will hear a girl talking about the school play that she has been in. What is she surprised about?

Girl: I was in the school play this term. All my friends and my family promised to come and watch me. And they did. It was great fun to see them when I was on stage. It was a long show. I had no idea, that performing is such hard work. At the end of each show, I just wanted to sleep!

20 You will hear a boy called Adam talking to a teacher.

Teacher: Adam, how can I help?

Adam: Well, Miss, there are exams next week. I need to start studying for them, but I always think that I might not do well.

Teacher: But exams aren’t scary.

Adam: Maybe not, but what if forget an important date in history, or write grammes instead of kilograms in physics?

Teacher: Well, if you do, it doesn’t matter. Just relax! If you’re nervous, you can’t think clearly in an exam.
parts.5:
Questions 21–25

Boy: What did you do when you were ill?

Girl: I just watched lots of videos! Like Scienceguy – he knows so much!

Boy: Yeah, he does!

Girl: He’s clever, the way he explains things.

Boy: I agree. Did you watch Dancer?

Girl: When he started dancing, in that shop, the other people looked scared! Perhaps they thought he was strange. But not me, I was laughing so much!

Boy: Have you seen Tiger?

Girl: Yes! I was a bit frightened. I thought that he might wake up, so I was scared.

Boy: Yeah. Me too. I like the old lady who does all these things with a glass of water …

Girl: Waterwoman?

Boy: Yeah!

Girl: She explains everything very well. That will help us with science. Which is great, because science lessons are boring.

Boy: Did you like Sleeping baby?

Girl: Well, she’s a lovely baby. But after a few seconds, I was thinking ‘OK, that’s enough!’

Boy: Yeah. I wanted to say ‘Stop!’ It wasn’t interesting at all. What about Mirrorman?

Girl: Oh, he always looks unhappy. And when I watched him, I felt the same!

Boy: Yes, I know what you mean!

explanations.p1q1: Nick 是主唱兼吉他手（"He’s the singer, and he plays the guitar as well."），乐队里有两台键盘——"it’s actually a keyboard, not a piano"、"another keyboard. That’s for the drums."——没有真钢琴也没有鼓手；B 有鼓组、C 有钢琴，因此选择 A。（题目页印 Jonas、文稿说 Nick，为同一乐队。）
explanations.p1q2: 女孩说冰箱里 "we’ve got mushrooms… and a box of eggs"——有蘑菇和一盒鸡蛋，牛奶也快喝完了（"the milk bottle’s nearly empty too"），但鸡蛋一个都不剩（"there are none left"），冰箱里实际有的是蘑菇，因此选择 C。
explanations.p1q3: 妈妈说不会付双程出租车费（"I’m not paying for a taxi both ways!"），提议他干脆走路回家（"why don’t you come all the way back on foot?"）；男孩最后坐公交（"I’ll get the bus home!"），但问题问的是妈妈想要的回家方式，因此选择 A。
explanations.p1q4: 开往伦敦的火车通常从 11 号站台发车，但那个站台 "closed until it’s repaired" 正在维修，工作人员说 "That train goes from platform one, in seven minutes."，现在改从 1 号站台发车；7 号站台只对应从伦敦开来的车（"It’s platform seven if you want the train that’s arriving from London."），因此选择 A。
explanations.p1q5: 男孩猜铅笔盒 "maybe it fell out of my jacket pocket and is still there."，妈妈确认 "I saw it on the back seat."，铅笔盒现在汽车后座上，因此选择 A。（官方 Key 误印为 C，C 图是厨房，只对应妈妈放车钥匙的位置，与文稿明确矛盾，按文稿取 A。）
explanations.p2q1: 正确答案是 June 5。女孩先报错日期又当场更正："I said June the fourth, didn’t I? Well, sorry, it’s not, it’s the fifth."——看电影的日子是 6 月 5 日；fourth 是她口误后的旧信息，不要误填。
explanations.p2q2: 正确答案是 Mercia。女孩说 "The only cinema where it’s on is called the Mercia Cinema. I’ll spell that; it’s M-E-R-C-I-A."——影院名叫 Mercia，她还逐字拼读确认了拼写。
explanations.p2q3: 正确答案是 Green。女孩说影院 "on Green Street, which is next to Park Street, where all the shops are"——在 Green Street；相邻的 Park Street 是商店街，只是位置描述里的干扰信息。
explanations.p2q4: 正确答案是 3:10。开映时间是 "the film starts at two fifty-five"，但前面有 "all those boring adverts first"，女孩不想看广告，约的是 "see each other there at ten past three"，即 3:10；别把开映的 2:55 当成见面时间。
explanations.p2q5: 正确答案是 75。女孩说 "most films are about a hundred minutes long? Well this one’s only seventy-five."——这部电影只有 75 分钟，特别短；100 分钟是大多数电影的常规时长，是干扰信息。
explanations.p3q1: Marina 说 Jack 提前办派对是 "because he just heard that he was chosen for the national hockey team for his age."——听说自己入选同龄组国家冰球队的好消息，并明确 "not at the end of the school year"，生日也在八月（"his birthday’s August"），因此选择 B。
explanations.p3q2: Marina 说朋友的乐队 "Yeah, they played songs from films."——派对上大家听的是现场演奏的音乐；"We wanted to dance, but the room was too small!" 说明想跳舞但房间太小没跳成，"songs from films" 只是演奏的电影歌曲，并没有看电影，因此选择 C。
explanations.p3q3: Marina 说 "Jack’s parents offered to cook, but not for so many people. So Jack asked everyone to bring snacks to share."——父母做不了这么多人的饭，Jack 让每人带零食来分享；男孩感叹 "Cheaper than ordering pizza!" 只是比较便宜，并没有订披萨，因此选择 A。
explanations.p3q4: 派对 "Eleven." 点结束，Marina 说 "I couldn’t believe it was time to go home so soon!"——她惊讶派对这么快就结束；回程公交上借夹克是因为 "it was cold outside"，并没有担心回家或弄丢夹克，因此选择 C。
explanations.p3q5: Marina 说 "my classmate Zara’s been really sad after her older sister moved to Australia."，派对让 Zara 好受多了，"By the end, she looked so happy."，被问到时她答 "Exactly, I really was."——她最享受的是看到朋友重新开心起来；而且她 "already knew everyone"，并没有认识很多新朋友，因此选择 C。
explanations.p4q1: 女孩说 "I need someone to ask me stuff in French so I can practise."——下周有法语口语考试，需要有人用法语向她提问来练习，爸爸答应 "OK, I can do that for you."；喜欢的电影等只是练习时谈的话题，不是要爸爸陪看电影或解释法语词汇，因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q2: Man 1 抱怨 "The water’s really cold! It’s horrible!"，Man 2 又说 "It’s the same if it’s too hot. You quickly get too exhausted to swim."——两人说的是水温冷热让他们难受；被问到泳池该有的温度时 Man 1 只答 "I don’t know"，没解释水为什么冷，也没谈哪种天气适合游泳，因此选择 C。
explanations.p4q3: 老师说两人 "both of you had exactly the same wrong answer."，觉得 "That shouldn’t be possible."，直接问 "Did one of you look at the other person’s work and write down the same answer? I need to hear the truth."——她想知道的是有没有人抄了对方的作业，因此选择 C。
explanations.p4q4: 女孩说 "I had no idea, that performing is such hard work."，每场演完 "I just wanted to sleep!"——她惊讶的是表演如此辛苦累人；家人朋友 "promised to come and watch me. And they did."，来看她演出并不意外，"It was great fun" 也不是她惊讶的内容，因此选择 A。
explanations.p4q5: Adam 说 "I need to start studying for them, but I always think that I might not do well."，还担心 "what if forget an important date in history, or write grammes instead of kilograms in physics?"——他在向老师说明自己担心考不好；老师只安慰 "Just relax!"，对话没有讲复习方法，也没有比较哪科最难，因此选择 A。
explanations.p5q1: 舞者在商店里起舞时 "the other people looked scared!"——旁观的人看起来吓了一跳，也许 "Perhaps they thought he was strange."，但女孩自己 "I was laughing so much!" 笑得特别厉害，即好笑的；strange 只是旁观者的猜测，不是女孩的评价，因此选择 C。
explanations.p5q2: 女孩看 Tiger 的时候有点害怕（"I was a bit frightened."），担心他醒来（"I thought that he might wake up, so I was scared."），自己也觉得 scared，即吓人的；男孩同样 "Yeah. Me too."，因此选择 E。
explanations.p5q3: Waterwoman 是用一杯水演示各种现象的老太太，"She explains everything very well." 讲解非常好，"That will help us with science." 对科学课有帮助，即有用的；"clever"（"He’s clever, the way he explains things."）说的是 Scienceguy，别张冠李戴，因此选择 H。
explanations.p5q4: 宝宝虽然可爱（"she’s a lovely baby"），但 "after a few seconds, I was thinking ‘OK, that’s enough!’" 看几秒就觉得够了，男孩也直言 "It wasn’t interesting at all." 没意思，即无聊的，因此选择 A。
explanations.p5q5: Mirrorman "he always looks unhappy." 总是看起来不开心，女孩看了 "I felt the same!" 也产生了同样的难过感觉，即悲伤的，男孩以 "Yes, I know what you mean!" 表示认同，因此选择 D。
